ideas.name: Block Puzzle
ideas.pitch: No timer, one-thumb play and an endless 'one more go' loop. Block Blast! was the most-downloaded mobile game of 2025 (356.2M installs).
ideas.fgsEdge: Ships free, no-ads and offline inside the 300 KB cap with a daily seeded board and a local high score.
ideas.mechanic: Drop polyominoes onto a 9x9 grid; clear full rows and columns.
ideas.caveats: Don't copy the names "Block Blast"/"Woodoku" or their art. The generic polyomino-placement mechanic is free to use.

ideas.name: Match-3 Swap
ideas.pitch: Short levels, a progression map and a strong daily habit loop. Candy Crush and Royal Match are perennial top-grossers.
ideas.fgsEdge: No ad-gating or paywalled lives: hand-tuned or procedurally generated levels, all free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Swap adjacent gems to match three or more across level goals.
ideas.caveats: Avoid "Crush", "Saga" and candy/king trade dress. A level map with 100+ hand-tuned or procedurally generated levels is the differentiator.

ideas.name: Triple Tile Match
ideas.pitch: Relaxing, visually tidy and easy to read: tap three identical tiles into a tray. Tile-match took ~503M downloads in 2025 (+28% YoY).
ideas.fgsEdge: No ads between taps; a daily seeded stack and local progress, all offline.
ideas.mechanic: Tap three identical tiles into a tray to clear the stack.
ideas.caveats: Generic mechanic. Use original icon art (an emoji or SVG set), not any store title's tiles.

ideas.name: Mahjong Solitaire
ideas.pitch: Calm pair-matching on stacked tile layouts, popular with an older-skewing audience thanks to large, readable tiles. Vita Mahjong ranked #7 worldwide in 2025.
ideas.fgsEdge: A free, no-tracking build with a senior-friendly large-tile mode and solvable daily layouts.
ideas.mechanic: Remove matching pairs of free tiles from a stacked layout.
ideas.caveats: Mahjong tile glyphs are public domain. Emphasise a large-tile / senior-friendly mode, a proven niche.

ideas.name: Sort Puzzle
ideas.pitch: Instantly readable, low-stress and hard to truly fail: sort colours into tubes or hex stacks. The sort subgenre took ~1B downloads in 2025.
ideas.fgsEdge: Several sort variants bundled free in one offline game, no ads or timers.
ideas.mechanic: Pour colours between tubes until each holds one colour.
ideas.caveats: Generic. Ship several sort variants (tubes, hex stacks) as one game.

ideas.name: Solitaire Family
ideas.pitch: Universally known card patience, played daily for decades across Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks and Pyramid.
ideas.fgsEdge: The whole patience family in one free, offline app with solver-checked daily deals.
ideas.mechanic: Build suit sequences and foundations from a shuffled deal.
ideas.caveats: Solitaire rules are public domain. Don't use "Microsoft" or others' card-back designs. Make daily deals winnable (solver-checked).

ideas.name: Daily Word Guess
ideas.pitch: A daily ritual with a shareable result grid and a three-minute session. NYT Wordle logged 4.2B plays in 2025.
ideas.fgsEdge: Original name and palette to stay clear of NYT's mark; free, offline, with a local streak.
ideas.mechanic: Guess a hidden 5-letter word in six tries with colour hints.
ideas.caveats: "Wordle" is NYT's trademark; in 2024 NYT sent DMCA takedowns to ~1,900 clones citing the name and the grid/tile-colour look and feel. Use an original name and consider a non-green/yellow palette.

ideas.name: Word Connect
ideas.pitch: Calm, vocabulary-flattering and endless: swipe letters to fill a crossword. Words of Wonders and Wordscapes each top 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: A permissively licensed wordlist keeps it free and offline, no ad walls between levels.
ideas.mechanic: Swipe letters to spell words that fill a crossword grid.
ideas.caveats: Use a permissively licensed wordlist (SCOWL/ENABLE, public-domain lists), not Scrabble dictionaries (Collins/Hasbro). Don't copy "Wordscapes" landscape trade dress.

ideas.name: Ludo
ideas.pitch: A family and social staple across South Asia and MENA. Ludo King passed 1B installs and led India's 2025 download chart.
ideas.fgsEdge: Local pass-and-play and vs-AI ship free and offline today; online arrives with a rooms primitive.
ideas.mechanic: Roll dice and race four tokens home around the board.
ideas.caveats: Ludo/Pachisi are public domain. Avoid "Ludo King" branding. Online play is the main draw.

ideas.name: Pool / Billiards
ideas.pitch: Physics satisfaction and quick PvP. 8 Ball Pool has over 1B downloads (a Guinness record).
ideas.fgsEdge: Free, offline cue sports with no Miniclip-style ad gating.
ideas.mechanic: Aim, set power and pot balls with cue physics.
ideas.caveats: Generic cue-sports mechanic. Avoid the Miniclip UI and branding.

ideas.name: Chess
ideas.pitch: Evergreen. Puzzles and vs-AI play are huge offline; Chess.com reports 250M members.
ideas.fgsEdge: Free offline vs-AI plus CC0 daily puzzles, no account required.
ideas.mechanic: Standard chess vs a small AI engine, plus daily puzzles.
ideas.caveats: Chess rules are public domain. The Lichess puzzle DB is CC0: a small subset can ship daily puzzles (watch bundle size).

ideas.name: Sudoku
ideas.pitch: Pure logic with endless generated content. Sudoku.com tops 100M installs and Meowdoku is currently #1 US Puzzle on both stores.
ideas.fgsEdge: Adds Killer and star-battle variants to the existing Sudoku, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Fill a 9x9 grid so each row, column and box holds 1-9.
ideas.caveats: Generic. LinkedIn "Queens" is a trademarked name, but the star-battle mechanic is public domain.

ideas.name: Connections Grouping
ideas.pitch: A daily, social 'aha' game: find four hidden groups of four. NYT Connections logged 1.6B solves in 2025, its second-biggest game.
ideas.fgsEdge: Original 16-word puzzles bundled for daily play, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Sort sixteen words into four hidden groups of four.
ideas.caveats: "Connections" is NYT branding. Use your own name/colours. Content must be original: budget ~365 original 16-word puzzles.

ideas.name: Snake .io
ideas.pitch: Instant, competitive feel in a browser tab. slither.io and Worms Zone each top 500M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: A free, no-tracking arena against AI bots, instantly in a browser tab.
ideas.mechanic: Steer a growing worm, eat orbs and avoid collisions.
ideas.caveats: Don't use the "slither.io" name.

ideas.name: Bubble Shooter
ideas.pitch: Classic aim-and-match casual play. Bubble Shooter - Classic Pop tops 500M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Classic bubble shooter, free and offline with local level saves.
ideas.mechanic: Aim and shoot bubbles to pop clusters of three or more.
ideas.caveats: Generic. Avoid "Bubble Witch"/"Puzzle Bobble" art.

ideas.name: Shedding Card Game
ideas.pitch: Family card-game nostalgia. UNO! tops 100M installs; the shedding mechanic is a social staple.
ideas.fgsEdge: A "Crazy Eights"-family build with an original deck, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Shed your hand by matching colour or rank, draw when stuck.
ideas.caveats: UNO and Phase 10 are Mattel trademarks and the card design is trade dress. Ship as a "Crazy Eights"-family game with an original name and deck.

ideas.name: Trivia Quiz
ideas.pitch: Social, learn-something quick rounds. Trivia Crack tops 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: An openly licensed question bank keeps daily quizzes free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Answer a daily set of multiple-choice questions against the clock.
ideas.caveats: The question bank must be original or openly licensed (Open Trivia DB is CC BY-SA 4.0: attribution + share-alike apply). Keep it small or lazy-load JSON chunks.

ideas.name: Brain Test Puzzles
ideas.pitch: Viral 'gotcha' humour: each level is a lateral-thinking trick. Brain Test tops 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Original lateral-thinking levels, free and offline with no ad gates.
ideas.mechanic: Solve bespoke lateral-thinking "gotcha" levels.
ideas.caveats: The concept is generic, but specific Brain Test puzzles are copyrightable: author original ones.

ideas.name: Jigsaw Puzzles
ideas.pitch: Relaxing assembly for an older audience. Easybrain's Jigsaw Puzzles tops 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: CC0 and procedurally generated images keep jigsaws free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Drag scattered pieces to reassemble a picture.
ideas.caveats: Images must be CC0/public domain or procedurally generated. Images are the big-asset constraint: use a small curated set plus procedural art.

ideas.name: Arrow Escape Puzzle
ideas.pitch: The current 2025-26 hit format: clear pieces in the right order. Arrows and Amaze GO each top 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Procedurally generated levels mean endless free, offline play with a daily seed.
ideas.mechanic: Tap pieces in the order that clears the board.
ideas.caveats: Generic mechanic.

ideas.name: Flow / Numberlink
ideas.pitch: Simple rules and satisfying fills: connect matching dots without crossing paths. Flow Free tops 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Procedural Numberlink boards, free and offline with a daily seed.
ideas.mechanic: Connect matching dots with non-crossing paths that fill the grid.
ideas.caveats: Numberlink is a public-domain puzzle type. "Flow Free" is a trademark.

ideas.name: Merge Numbers (2248)
ideas.pitch: Instantly learnable yet deep number-merging. 2248 Numbers tops 50M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Builds on MIT-licensed 2048 to add 2248 and drop-merge variants, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Slide and merge numbered tiles up a chain.
ideas.caveats: 2048 is MIT-licensed open source. Fine to build on.

ideas.name: Number Match
ideas.pitch: A retro pen-and-paper puzzle for an older audience: clear pairs that sum to ten or match. Number Match tops 50M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: A free, offline daily Number Match with local stats.
ideas.mechanic: Clear pairs that match or sum to ten.
ideas.caveats: Generic (Numberzilla / Take Ten traditional pen-and-paper puzzle).

ideas.name: Nonogram
ideas.pitch: Logic plus a pixel-art reveal. Nonogram.com tops 50M installs with 904K reviews.
ideas.fgsEdge: Procedurally generated nonograms, free and offline with a daily seed.
ideas.mechanic: Fill grid cells from row/column clues to reveal pixel art.
ideas.caveats: "Picross" is a Nintendo trademark. Use "Nonogram"/"Griddlers".

ideas.name: Crossword
ideas.pitch: A daily habit. CodyCross tops 100M installs and the NYT Mini logged 1.4B solves in 2025.
ideas.fgsEdge: A 5x5 daily mini fits a seeded model, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Solve a daily 5x5 crossword from original clues.
ideas.caveats: Clues must be original. A 5x5 "mini" format needs far less content and fits a daily-seed model.

ideas.name: Word Search / Strands
ideas.pitch: Low-stress, daily word hunting. NYT Strands logged 1.5B solves; Word Search Explorer is #1 US Word on Play.
ideas.fgsEdge: Adds a themed snake-path mode to the existing Word Search, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Find themed words along snaking paths in a letter grid.
ideas.caveats: "Strands" is NYT branding. Use your own name for the themed snake-path variant.

ideas.name: Trick-Taking Cards
ideas.pitch: A huge US social card audience across Spades, Hearts and Euchre. Multiple Spades titles sit in the US Card top 30.
ideas.fgsEdge: Free offline Spades and Hearts vs-AI; online tables await a rooms primitive.
ideas.mechanic: Bid and take tricks vs AI partners and opponents.
ideas.caveats: Public-domain rules (Spades, Hearts, Euchre).

ideas.name: Dice (Yatzy / Farkle)
ideas.pitch: Quick luck-plus-choice dice play. Yahtzee With Buddies and Yatzy each top 10M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: A free, offline Yatzy/Farkle with local high scores.
ideas.mechanic: Roll five dice and bank scoring combinations.
ideas.caveats: "Yahtzee" is a Hasbro trademark. Use "Yatzy" / "Five Dice".

ideas.name: Screw Puzzle
ideas.pitch: A hybrid-casual hit format: unscrew bolts to free pieces. The screw subgenre took ~399M downloads in 2025.
ideas.fgsEdge: 2D physics-lite screw puzzles, free and offline with a daily seed.
ideas.mechanic: Unscrew coloured bolts to free and sort pieces.
ideas.caveats: Generic nuts-and-bolts mechanic.

ideas.name: Piano Tiles
ideas.pitch: Music plus reflex tapping. Magic Tiles 3 and Tiles Hop each top 500M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Public-domain tunes synthesised in WebAudio keep the bundle tiny and free.
ideas.mechanic: Tap falling tiles in time with a public-domain tune.
ideas.caveats: Songs are the IP risk. Use only public-domain compositions synthesised in WebAudio (no recordings); keeps the bundle tiny.

ideas.name: Dominoes / Pips
ideas.pitch: Pips shows strong demand for a daily domino-placement logic puzzle (612M solves in 2025).
ideas.fgsEdge: A daily seeded domino-logic puzzle plus classic dominoes, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Place dominoes to match pips in a daily logic puzzle.
ideas.caveats: Dominoes are public domain. "Pips" is NYT branding.

ideas.name: Backgammon
ideas.pitch: A classic with a loyal MENA and European audience. Backgammon (AI Factory) tops 10M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Free offline backgammon vs-AI with local win tracking.
ideas.mechanic: Bear off checkers by dice rolls vs AI.
ideas.caveats: Public domain.

ideas.name: Sea Battle
ideas.pitch: Simple two-player deduction. Sea Battle 2 tops 50M installs with 1.61M reviews.
ideas.fgsEdge: Local hot-seat ships free today; online with commit-reveal awaits rooms.
ideas.mechanic: Guess coordinates to sink the opponent's hidden fleet.
ideas.caveats: "Battleship" is a Hasbro trademark. Use "Sea Battle"/"Fleet".

ideas.name: Idle Clicker
ideas.pitch: Progress while away. Idle Miner Tycoon tops 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: A free, no-ads idle loop with offline progress from the client clock.
ideas.mechanic: Tap to earn, buy upgrades, accrue offline progress.
ideas.caveats: Generic. Offline progress must use the client timestamp (cheatable, fine for a solo build).

ideas.name: Stack / Helix
ideas.pitch: One-tap, 30-second sessions. Helix Jump tops 100M installs; Stack tops 50M.
ideas.fgsEdge: Stack ships in the 300 KB tier; Helix uses the 600 KB 3D tier, both free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: One-tap drops down a rotating helix or a stacking tower.
ideas.caveats: Avoid Ketchapp/Voodoo names. Helix needs 3D and the 600 KB tier.

ideas.name: 2-Player Party Pack
ideas.pitch: Offline, same-device social play. 2 Player Games: the Challenge tops 100M installs.
ideas.fgsEdge: Reuses existing FGS minis as one free, offline same-device party pack.
ideas.mechanic: Two players share one screen across quick minigames.
ideas.caveats: Generic. Reuses existing FGS minigames.

ideas.name: Brain-Training Suite
ideas.pitch: Self-improvement framing across memory, attention and speed drills. Lumosity claims 100M users.
ideas.fgsEdge: A free suite of brain minis with local progress and no benefit claims.
ideas.mechanic: Train across memory, attention and speed minigames.
ideas.caveats: Avoid unsupported cognitive-benefit claims (the FTC fined Lumosity $2M in 2016 over such claims).

ideas.name: Cryptogram / Hive Words
ideas.pitch: An older word-puzzle audience. NYT Spelling Bee logged 667M solves in 2025.
ideas.fgsEdge: Original hive words and public-domain cryptogram quotes, free and offline.
ideas.mechanic: Spell words from a honeycomb, or decode a cryptogram.
ideas.caveats: "Spelling Bee" (NYT) as a product name: use "Hive"/"Honeycomb Words". Cryptogram quotes must be public domain.

ideas.name: Checkers & Classics
ideas.pitch: Classic, easy-AI board and word games: checkers, four-in-a-row, reversi, tic-tac-toe and hangman.
ideas.fgsEdge: All five classics ship free and offline vs-AI under generic names.
ideas.mechanic: Classic board and word games vs an easy AI.
ideas.caveats: "Connect 4" is a Hasbro trademark and "Othello" is registered: prefer "Four in a Row"/"Reversi". Hangman and checkers are public domain.

ideas.name: Mancala / Go / Shogi
ideas.pitch: Niche but loyal regional classics: Mancala, Go and Shogi.
ideas.fgsEdge: Free offline builds of Mancala, Go and Shogi with local win tracking.
ideas.mechanic: Sow seeds or place stones vs AI across regional classics.
ideas.caveats: Public domain (Mancala, Go, Shogi).
